mapper.select: SELECT * FROM questions ORDER BY category_id ASC, order_num ASC
SELECT * FROM questions WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY order_num ASC
SELECT * FROM questions WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND is_active = true ORDER BY order_num ASC
SELECT * FROM questions WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND is_active = true ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM questions WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND is_active = true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO questions (category_id, title, description, file_url, flag, points, difficulty, order_num, is_active) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{fileUrl}, #{flag}, #{points}, #{difficulty}, #{orderNum}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE questions SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, file_url = #{fileUrl}, flag = #{flag}, points = #{points}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, order_num = #{orderNum}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
